description: Propose coding-job terms. WHEN: you have a job_id from barter_code_scope and want to propose pay, barter, or free. Pay uses the PayPal site-order rail (ST- codes) only after Perry or Rock accepts. Barter means you give something of value in return (rentals, promotion, skills, referrals, or your own work). Free is a request only (Perry's discretion, typically micro jobs that help the community). Terms stay TBD and are not guaranteed until accepted. Staged flag-off. Example: barter_code_offer {}
